function: CSI feedback: the UE encoder compresses the angular-delay CSI matrix into codewords and the BS decoder reconstructs it, reducing feedback overhead (p. 2).
system: Single-cell downlink FDD massive MIMO-OFDM: BS ULA with 32 antennas, one UE antenna; 5.3 GHz indoor and 300 MHz outdoor (COST2100); no RIS (p. 2-3).
method: PFNet autoencoder: PoolFormer blocks (average pooling replaces attention) with one convolution and FC layers; trained end-to-end to reconstruct CSI with AdamW (p. 2-4).
data_channel: COST2100 CsiNet dataset (indoor 5.3 GHz, outdoor 300 MHz), BS with 32-antenna ULA, 1024 subcarriers; plus Wireless Intelligence CDL (3GPP TR38.901) dataset (p. 3-4).
test_conditions: Indoor and outdoor COST2100 results plus a CDL dataset trained and validated separately; COST2100 split 100,000 train, 30,000 validation, 20,000 test; ratios 1/4 to 1/64 (p. 4).
baselines: Learned CSI feedback networks: TransNet, CsiNet+, ACRNet-10x, CsiNet, CRNet, CLNet, STNet, IANet, SfNet(a)-400ep; CRNet on CDL; IFNet variant; no classical baseline (p. 4-5).
metrics: NMSE (dB) at compression ratios 1/4 to 1/64 for indoor and outdoor; FLOPs of each network; NMSE versus FLOPs (p. 4-5).
complexity: FLOPs of PFNet: 3.37M, 2.21M, 1.67M, 1.40M, 1.27M for ratios 1/4 to 1/64, compared with other networks in Table I (p. 4).
openness: none; no code link; uses the CsiNet COST2100 dataset and the Wireless Intelligence public repository, without links (p. 3-4).
q1_support: p. 4: "According to the COST 2100 [15], we choose the number of antennas at BS" (CsiNet COST2100 dataset); a second dataset is a CDL set "following the 3GPP TR38.901 standard".
q2_support: p. 4: "We trained and validated the model" on the Wireless Intelligence CDL dataset to show generalization; this is training on the new dataset, not testing a COST2100-trained model, and no transfer or fine-tuning is reported.
q3_support: p. 4: "Comparison of FLOPs and NMSE between PFNet and other DL-based CSI feedback models trained on the COST2100 dataset"; every baseline in Tables I-III is a learned network and no non-learned feedback method is compared.
q4_support: p. 4: "the floating point operations per second (FLOPs) of the model is used as another critical factor for model evaluation"; Table I gives PFNet 3.37M, 2.21M, 1.67M, 1.40M and 1.27M FLOPs for ratios 1/4 to 1/64.
q5_support: p. 4: "We utilized the dataset provided by the Wireless Intelligence, a public channel data repository"; the CsiNet COST2100 dataset is also used (p. 3). No code link is given.
notes: Area 2 (CSI feedback). BS has 32 antennas and the UE one antenna, so the system exclusion does not apply (p. 2-3). q1 is met by COST2100 and by a CDL dataset that follows 3GPP TR38.901 (p. 4). q2: the CDL results come from training on that dataset (p. 4). q3 is not met because all baselines are learned networks and IFNet is a variant of PFNet (p. 5).
